title: On the right track
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
How do you know when you are 'on the right track' in life if there is no clear measurement?
Have you ever changed direction after realising a plan no longer suited you?
Should people stick with a difficult goal longer, or change course earlier when it is not working?
Whose advice do you trust when making a major life decision?
What sign would convince you that it is time to choose a different path?
